coreIdea: Take the BTC 15m leg whose order book shows stronger bid-depth support (top-N cumulative depth ratio differential between the legs) with one FOK taker buy and hold to fee-free redemption, re-testing the measured book-imbalance gross edge under a single taker fee.

experiments.hypothesis: Buying the leg with the higher top-of-book bid-depth ratio (differential >= minImbalance) and holding to fee-free redemption captures the measured book-imbalance gross taker edge (+$0.056/mkt, net ~$0 at round-trip fees) at roughly half the fee drag, netting positive.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: All cells net-positive: 0.1 → +0.48 (run 256, 879/1000 played, 1027 trades, 54.84% win), 0.2 → +0.31 (run 253), 0.3 → +0.24 (run 254), 0.4 → +0.40 (run 255). Non-monotonic, and participation is nearly flat (879→858) — the threshold barely binds in this range; cell spread is mostly entry-timing jitter. 0.1 best and stable across halves (last-500 +0.53 vs all +0.48), 8/11 live days positive, both weeks positive.

Signal lives at the touch: 1 → +0.51 (run 260, 878/1000, 55.24% win, 2 neg days), 3 → +0.48 (run 257, exact replica of run 256 — determinism check passed), 5 → +0.05 (run 258), 10 → -0.07 (run 259). Plateau at levels 1-3, collapse beyond — deeper cumulative depth dilutes the informative liquidity near the touch.

Plateau at 0.7-0.9: 0.7 → +0.58 (run 261, last500 +0.40), 0.8 → +0.51 (run 262, last500 +0.46), 0.9 → +0.54 (run 263, last500 +0.47); 0.6 collapses to +0.21 (run 264, last500 -0.13, 46.01% win). Participation identical (878/1000 everywhere) — the cap shifts entry timing, not selection. 0.8 picked as plateau center with most balanced halves; 0.7/0.9 within noise.

ISOLATED SPIKE, not a plateau: 0 → -0.63 (run 268, 48.11% win), 60 → +0.51 (run 265, 55.24% win), 180 → -0.17 (run 266, 46.17% win), 420 → -0.65 (run 267, 31.58% win). The whole edge lives at the 60s entry; both neighbors are negative. Win-rate gap 60s-vs-180s (55.24 vs 46.17 on ~875 mkts) is ~5σ — real in this window, but fragile-timing advisory for the gate. 420s at 31.58% win: late-window imbalance ANTI-predicts under taker-buy — roadmap #5 (late-window) is measured hostile as stated; a reverse-signal variant is the testable version.

Flat per-share — exposure knob, not edge: 10 → +0.24 (run 271, 2.4¢/share), 20 → +0.51 (run 269, 2.55¢/share), 40 → +1.03 (run 270, 2.57¢/share, 55.34% win, slight FOK-kill uptick: 871 vs 878 played). No capacity wall up to 40 shares. Kept 20 (default) — argmaxing exposure is leverage, not signal; stop spending passes here.

Flat — param doesn't matter: 0.01 → +0.46 (run 274, 856/1000 played), 0.02 → +0.51 (run 272, 878/1000), 0.04 → +0.47 (run 273, 890/1000). Tolerance trades a few FOK kills for a few worse fills; EV within noise. Kept 0.02.

refine.note: Oscillating, not a pocket: 30 → +0.52 (run 278, 55.25% win), 45 → -0.11 (run 275, 51.03%), 60 → +0.51 (run 265, 55.24%), 90 → +0.17 (run 276, 52.05%), 120 → -0.13 (run 277, 49.1%). Adjacent swings each ~1.8σ — consistent with a noisy hill over 30-90s (neighborhood mean ≈ +0.27), not a stable +0.5 plateau. Kept startSec=60 (30 is +0.01 within noise; all judged passes used 60). Advisory: best-cell +0.51 likely overstates out-of-sample edge.

gateLog.note: Best cell netEv +0.51/mkt at 1000 mkts (run 265: imbLevels=1, minImbalance=0.1, size=20, startSec=60, maxEntryPrice=0.8, slippageTol=0.02; 878/1000 played, 1023 taker trades, 55.24% win, fees $110.3, gross ≈ +0.62/mkt) — gate 1 criterion netEvPerMarket > 0 met. Advisories (non-blocking): startSec response oscillates (45s → -0.11 while 30/60 → +0.5); coverage is a single 11-day June 2026 window; minImbalance barely binds so the entry is effectively 'first tick after 60s'. Extending run 265 to 3000 markets.
